title: Integration auth test is included in the default unit test command but excluded from the integration command
reasoning: `npm run test` excludes only files matching `**/*.integration.test.ts`, while the integration test is named `auth.test.tsx` under `app/__tests__/integration`. That means the default unit test command will run this router/auth integration test, but `npm run test:integration` only targets `app/queries/__tests__/*.integration.test.ts` and will not run it. This makes CI/test selection misleading and can cause integration-only failures to appear in the unit suite while being missed by the integration suite.
recommendation: Rename the file to an integration-test suffix covered by the scripts and broaden `test:integration` to include `app/__tests__/integration`, or update the default exclusion to skip the integration directory.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: This is a test harness configuration issue; the test itself cannot assert which npm script selects it.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a script-level check or standardize test file naming so integration tests use `*.integration.test.tsx` and are discovered by `npm run test:integration`.
